L51: ## Three modes in one
L52: 
L53: Nintendo Switch is designed to fit your life, transforming from home console to portable system in a snap.
L54: 
L55: 【42†Image: †assets.nintendo.com】
L56: 
L57: ## TV mode
L58: 
L59: Dock your system to enjoy HD gaming on your TV.
L60: ## Tabletop mode
L61: 
L62: Flip the stand to share the screen, then share the fun with a multiplayer game.
L63: 
L64: ## Handheld mode
L65: 
L66: Pick it up and play with the Joy-Con™ controllers attached to enjoy the 6.2" LCD touch screen
L67: 
L68: ## This is Joy‑Con™
L69: 
L70: The included Joy‑Con controllers give you total gameplay flexibility.
L71: 
L72: 【43†Image†assets.nintendo.com】

L74: ## Choose your control style
L75: 
L76: One controller or two, vertical or sideways, attached to the console or separate. You can play multiple ways, depending on the game.
L77: ## Share with a friend
L78: 
L79: Flip the stand to share the screen, then share the fun with a multiplayer game.
L80: 
L81: ## Try something new
L82: 
L83: HD Rumble puts you in the game with physical feedback, while the IR Motion Camera opens up new experiences.
L84:
